answer: Ember-Locked Random Assignment: each period a public beacon publishes randomness no one can precompute. Agents are assigned tasks in jade-sharded groups derived from that beacon, and only groups completing a ferrous commitment round (posting a live collateral signature within the window) earn assignment rights. An attacker must staff every shard with real, responding identities before the beacon reveals grouping; pre-planting fails since the assignment is unknowable in advance. Cost: maintaining proportionally many live collateral postings per period, scaling with the shard count.
